note:
String literals built only from interpolations and punctuation, ruled non-copy in the exact file they appear in.

A literal with no letters carries nothing for the candidate rule to see, so a sentence assembled from two already-translated halves and a separator -- "\(what) . \(state)" -- is invisible to every other gate here. Anything of that shape is therefore an error unless someone recorded why it is a format rather than a sentence: an identifier, a path, a keychain key, an address and port. Scoped to file and literal; there is no global exemption, and a declaration for a literal the file no longer contains fails.

apple/Packages/SparkAPI/Sources/SparkAPI.\\(…)=\\(…): A process environment entry assembled from a fixed key and value. Process data, never shown.

apple/Packages/SparkAPI/Sources/SparkAPI.\\(…) (\\(…)): A simulator name with its runtime, advertised to the Spark in the build-worker registration. Wire data, never copy.
apple/Packages/SparkAPI/Sources/SparkAPI.\\(…) \\(…): A runtime identifier such as iOS-26-5 re-joined as iOS 26.5 for the same registration field. Wire data.

apple/Packages/SparkBootstrap/Sources/Sp.\\(…)/\\(…): A path under the bootstrap work directory. Filesystem, not prose.

apple/Packages/SparkBootstrap/Sources/Sp.\\(…):\\(…): A conflict's identity, for SwiftUI diffing. Never rendered.

apple/Packages/SparkBootstrap/Sources/Sp.\\(…)://\\(…): A URL scheme and route joined into a pairing link prefix. A wire format iOS matches on, never shown.

apple/Packages/SparkBootstrap/Sources/Sp.\\(…)-\\(…): A release identity, channel and version. Matches the signed manifest.

apple/Packages/SparkCore/Sources/SparkCo.\\(…)@\\(…): A model identity and its recipe revision, in the form the runtime uses.

apple/Packages/SparkIntents/Sources/Spar.\\(…)/\\(…)/\\(…): A Spotlight item's unique identifier. Indexed, never shown.

apple/Packages/SparkProjects/Sources/Spa.\\(…).\\(…).\\(…): Target, project and change identifiers used as the SwiftUI task identity for fetching one exact review, never rendered.

apple/Packages/SparkProjects/Sources/Spa.\\(…) \\(…): A unified-diff marker and source line, preserved as code rather than prose.

apple/Packages/SparkProjects/Sources/Spa.\\(…)::\\(…): A target and project identity used only as an in-memory cache key.

apple/Packages/SparkSecurity/Sources/Spa.\\(…)/\\(…): A keychain service and account, as one lookup key. A translated key finds nothing.

apple/SparkApp/Shared/ExternalClusterPre.\\(…):\\(…): A library entry and node identity, as one row identity.
apple/SparkApp/Shared/ExternalClusterPre.\\(…):\\(…):\\(…): A fabric link's identity: two node identities and a port.

apple/SparkApp/Shared/ExternalClusterPre.\\(…):\\(…): A library entry and node identity, as one row identity.

apple/SparkApp/Shared/FleetDetailsPresen.\\(…):\\(…): A host and port, as the route states them. The same in every language.

apple/SparkApp/Shared/InviteDeviceView.s.\\(…) \\(…): A six-digit pairing code split into two groups of three, for reading aloud. Digits, not words.

apple/SparkApp/Shared/SparkActionableNot.\\(…).\\(…): Target and service/project identifiers used as durable notification state keys, never rendered.
apple/SparkApp/Shared/SparkActionableNot.\\(…).\\(…).\\(…): Target, project and change identifiers used as exact review navigation identity, never rendered.

apple/SparkApp/Shared/SparkAutomations.s.\\(…) \\(…) * * *: A five-field schedule expression the runtime parses. Protocol, not prose; translating a field would change when the automation fires.
apple/SparkApp/Shared/SparkAutomations.s.\\(…) \\(…) * * 1-5: A five-field schedule expression the runtime parses. Protocol, not prose; translating a field would change when the automation fires.
apple/SparkApp/Shared/SparkAutomations.s.\\(…) */\\(…) * * *: A five-field schedule expression the runtime parses. Protocol, not prose; translating a field would change when the automation fires.
apple/SparkApp/Shared/SparkAutomations.s.\\(…) \\(…) * * \\(…): A five-field schedule expression the runtime parses. Protocol, not prose; translating a field would change when the automation fires.

apple/SparkApp/Shared/SparkChatPersonalS.- \\(…) \\(…) [\\(…)]: One personal-context line the model reads: a time, a sanitised title and its list name.
apple/SparkApp/Shared/SparkChatPersonalS.\\(…) \\(…): A day and a clock time inside the personal-context block.
apple/SparkApp/Shared/SparkChatPersonalS.\\(…) \\(…)-\\(…): A day and a start-to-end clock range inside the personal-context block.

apple/SparkApp/Shared/SparkNotifications.\\(…):\\(…): A target and operation identity, as one key.
